name: Grade 6 T1 Practice: March Week 2 - Sending Messages
description: Practice words for sending messages and packet order.

words.definition: To move a message to another person or place.
words.example: The computer can send a message online.

words.definition: To get a message from another person or place.
words.example: The browser can receive information from a website.
A packet is one part of a message.
Packets need to be put back in order.

words.definition: Not there when it should be.
words.example: The message was hard to read when one packet was missing.

words.definition: The path something takes to get somewhere.
words.example: A packet can take a route through the network.

words.definition: Getting something to the correct place.
words.example: Packet delivery helps the message arrive.
